_readme: Places that publications in the register are about, matched in titles, subtitles and
abstracts by regions.py, and in the 'regional focus' line of zmo.de people pages.
Hand-curated: each place has a Wikidata id (verified with gazetteer_check.py, which also
fills in coordinates in raw_data/places.json), its names in English, German and French, and
the demonyms and adjectives titles use. Name syntax: matching ignores case and works on
whole words; a trailing * matches any ending ('syrisch*' = syrisch, syrische, syrischen…);
a leading = makes the name case-sensitive ('=Chad', '=Georgia'). Longer names win, so
'Indian Ocean' is never read as India and 'Niger Delta' is Nigeria, not Niger.
'wikidata_en' records an accepted difference between our name and Wikidata's label.
'ignore' phrases are removed before matching: an institution's name ('ZMO Berlin'), a
place named after another ('Gulf of Guinea'), a period ('Middle Ages').
A place marked ambiguous ('Tripoli', 'Georgia', 'Jordan', 'Benin') has every match listed
in reports/regions-review.md; decisions on individual records go in regions_review.json.
macro groups places into eight regions — the size of the categorical palette — plus a
grey 'transregional' group for continents, seas and worlds, which are listed but not mapped.
